```{=html}
<!-- Subscribe box: front-end only for now. When the newsletter phase lands
     (listmonk), point the form action at its /subscription endpoint. -->
<div class="leap-subscribe">
  <h3>Get new articles by owl&hellip; or email</h3>
  <p>Every new article, straight to your inbox. No spam, no forwarding to Mordor.</p>
  <form id="leap-subscribe-form">
    <input type="email" name="email" placeholder="you@bagend.me" required
           aria-label="Email address">
    <button type="submit">Subscribe</button>
  </form>
  <script>
    document.getElementById("leap-subscribe-form").addEventListener("submit", function (e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      this.innerHTML = '<div class="leap-subscribe-done">Thanks! Subscriptions go live when the newsletter launches &mdash; this mock just says hello.</div>';
    });
  </script>
</div>
```
